# 1. Configuration & Setup

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 1.1 GLOBAL DIRECTORY & PIPELINE CONFIGURATION
# ==============================================================================

# Experiment identifier. Matches upstream Python pre-processing output nomenclature.
experiment_id <- "E1" 

# Parent directory containing all component-specific subdirectories.
root_dir <- "C:/Code/UG_ERP_Project/results/EEG" 

# Temporal step size (in milliseconds) for high-density topographic grids.
time_course_step_ms <- 40 

# ==============================================================================
# 1.2 DEPENDENCY MANAGEMENT
# ==============================================================================
if(!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, stringr, fs, gridExtra, scales, here, cowplot, purrr)

# eegUtils is strictly required for topographic interpolation and spatial mapping.
if (!require("eegUtils")) {
  stop("Critical Package Missing: 'eegUtils'. Install via devtools::install_github('craddm/eegUtils')")
}

# ==============================================================================
# 1.3 COMPONENT & SPATIOTEMPORAL DEFINITIONS
# ==============================================================================
# Dynamic FRN window logic mirroring upstream Python architecture constraints.
frn_window <- if (experiment_id == "E1") c(250, 300) else c(200, 250)

# Component parameter definitions synchronized with preprocessing models.
component_specs <- list(
  N170 = list(win_ms = c(150, 200), roi = c("P7", "P8", "PO7", "PO8"), source_comp = "N170"),
  EPN = list(win_ms = c(250, 350), roi = c("PO7", "PO8", "P7", "P8", "O1", "O2"), source_comp = "EPN"),
  FRN = list(win_ms = frn_window, roi = c("F3", "Fz", "F4", "FC1", "FC2", "Cz"), source_comp = "FRN"),
  N400 = list(win_ms = c(350, 450), roi = c("Cz", "CPz", "Pz"), source_comp = "N400"),
  LPP_offer = list(win_ms = c(500, 800), roi = c("Pz", "Cz", "C1", "C2", "CP1", "CP2"), source_comp = "LPP_offer"),
  
  testN170 = list(win_ms = c(150, 350), roi = c("P7", "P8", "PO7", "PO8"), source_comp = "N170"),
  testEPN = list(win_ms = c(200, 400), roi = c("PO7", "PO8", "P7", "P8", "O1", "O2"), source_comp = "EPN"),
  testFRN = list(win_ms = c(200, 250), roi = c("F3", "Fz", "F4", "FC1", "FC2", "Cz"), source_comp = "FRN"),
  testN400 = list(win_ms = c(300, 500), roi = c("Cz", "CPz", "Pz"), source_comp = "N400"),
  testLPP = list(win_ms = c(400, 600), roi = c("Pz", "Cz", "C1", "C2", "CP1", "CP2"), source_comp = "LPP_offer")
)

# Formal nomenclature aligned with upstream Python pipeline ('enj' mapped to Reward).
# Keys represent internal logic; Values represent publication-ready presentation labels.
emotion_list <- c("aff", "dis", "dom", "enj")
emotion_labels <- c(neu = "Neutral", aff = "Affiliative", dis = "Disgust", dom = "Dominance", enj = "Reward")
offer_types  <- c("fair", "unfair")

cat(sprintf("Pipeline Initialized.\nTarget Experiment: %s\nData Root: %s\n", experiment_id, root_dir))

```

# 2. Methodological Helper Functions

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# Dynamic Scale Limit Computation (Adaptive Precision Method)
# Evaluates pooled magnitude to determine optimal rounding step, maximizing 
# visual contrast for weak signals while maintaining zero-center symmetry.
# ==============================================================================
compute_limits <- function(values, symmetric = TRUE, prob_thresh = 0.99) {
  if (all(is.na(values))) return(c(-0.1, 0.1))
  
  if (symmetric) {
    max_val <- quantile(abs(values), probs = prob_thresh, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.infinite(max_val) || max_val == 0) return(c(-0.1, 0.1))
    
    # Adaptive step resolution based on overall signal magnitude
    if (max_val <= 0.5) {
      step <- 0.05
    } else if (max_val <= 1.0) {
      step <- 0.1
    } else if (max_val <= 2.5) {
      step <- 0.25
    } else {
      step <- 0.5
    }
    
    max_val <- ceiling(max_val / step) * step
    if (max_val == 0) max_val <- step 
    
    return(c(-max_val, max_val))
  } else {
    return(quantile(values, probs = c(1 - prob_thresh, prob_thresh), na.rm = TRUE))
  }
}

# ==============================================================================
# Unified Publication-Ready Topographic Plotting Engine
# Reverted to native eegUtils ROI highlighting for maximum stability.
# ==============================================================================
plot_topo_unified <- function(dat_long, chan_locs, roi, 
                              main_title, sub_title, caption_text, 
                              filename, limits, show_contour = TRUE) {
  
  if(!"electrode" %in% names(dat_long)) {
    warning("Spatial mapping failure: 'electrode' identifier absent.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  safe_title <- str_wrap(main_title, width = 50)
  safe_sub   <- str_wrap(sub_title, width = 50)

  # Core execution: utilizing package-native highlighting mechanics.
  p <- topoplot(
    dat_long, chan_locs = chan_locs, interp_limit = "head",
    contour = show_contour, points = TRUE, highlights = roi,
    palette = "RdBu", limits = limits
  ) +
    labs(title = safe_title, subtitle = safe_sub, caption = caption_text) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t=10, b=5)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey20", margin = margin(b=15)),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 1, color = "grey40", face = "italic", margin = margin(t=20)),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      plot.margin = margin(25, 25, 25, 25),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title = "Amplitude\n(µV)", barheight = unit(6, "cm"), barwidth = unit(0.6, "cm"), ticks.linewidth = 1))
  
  ggsave(filename, plot = p, device = "png", width = 7.0, height = 6.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  return(p)
}

```

# 3. Component Processing & Visualization Engine

```{r}
for (comp_name in names(component_specs)) {
  
  spec <- component_specs[[comp_name]]
  time_win_str <- paste0(spec$win_ms[1], " - ", spec$win_ms[2], " ms")
  
  target_source <- ifelse(!is.null(spec$source_comp), spec$source_comp, comp_name)
  target_folder_name <- paste0("Results_", target_source, "_", experiment_id)
  comp_results_dir   <- file.path(root_dir, target_folder_name)
  
  cat(paste0("\n", str_dup("#", 75), "\n"))
  cat(sprintf("ANALYSIS TARGET: %s | PHYSICAL SOURCE: %s\n", comp_name, target_folder_name))
  cat(paste0(str_dup("#", 75), "\n"))
  
  if (!dir_exists(comp_results_dir)) {
    cat(sprintf("Directory unresolved: %s. Skipping.\n", comp_results_dir))
    next
  }
  
  sessions <- dir_ls(comp_results_dir, glob = "*Session_*", type = "directory")
  if (length(sessions) == 0) {
    cat("Session index empty. Skipping.\n")
    next
  }
  current_session <- sort(sessions, decreasing = TRUE)[1]
  
  chan_file <- file.path(current_session, "Regression_Results", "channel_locations.csv")
  if (!file.exists(chan_file)) chan_file <- file.path(current_session, "Standard_Baseline", "channel_locations.csv")
  if (!file.exists(chan_file)) {
    cat("Spatial montage missing. Skipping.\n")
    next
  }
  
  chanlocs <- read_csv(chan_file, show_col_types = FALSE, lazy = FALSE) %>% rename(electrode = channel)
  methods_to_run <- c("Regression", "Standard")
  
  for (method in methods_to_run) {
    if (method == "Regression" && comp_name != target_source) {
      cat(sprintf("\n  >>> Analytical Method: %s [GUARD INTERCEPT] Skipped.\n", method))
      next
    }
    
    cat(sprintf("\n  >>> Analytical Method: %s\n", method))
    topo_data <- NULL; title_prefix <- ""; caption_method <- ""
    
    # ==========================================================================
    # 3.1 DATA INGESTION 
    # ==========================================================================
    if (method == "Regression") {
      f <- file.path(current_session, "Regression_Results", "topomap_data_for_R", paste0(target_source, "_topomap_data.csv"))
      if (file.exists(f)) {
        topo_data <- read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE, lazy = FALSE)
        title_prefix <- "Marginal Means (Regression)"
        caption_method <- "Estimates derived via linear modeling (Z-scored Baseline)"
      } else { cat("    File absent. Skipping.\n"); next }
      
    } else if (method == "Standard") {
      f <- file.path(current_session, "Standard_Baseline", paste0(target_source, "_ave_labelled.csv"))
      if (file.exists(f)) {
        raw_df <- read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE, lazy = FALSE)
        valid_chans <- intersect(names(raw_df), chanlocs$electrode)
        
        df_agg <- raw_df %>%
          pivot_longer(all_of(valid_chans), names_to = "channel", values_to = "uV") %>%
          mutate(time_ms = round(time * 1000)) %>%
          filter(time_ms >= spec$win_ms[1] & time_ms <= spec$win_ms[2]) %>%
          group_by(channel, emotion, offer_type) %>%
          summarise(mean_amp = mean(uV, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
        
        topo_data <- df_agg %>%
          pivot_wider(names_from = c(emotion, offer_type), values_from = mean_amp, names_sep = "_") %>%
          rename_with(~paste0("raw_", .), -channel)
          
        title_prefix <- "Evoked Amplitude (Standard)"
        caption_method <- "Traditional Pre-stimulus Subtraction (-200 to 0 ms)"
      } else { cat("    File absent. Skipping.\n"); next }
    }
    
    # ==========================================================================
    # 3.2 FACTORIAL DIFFERENCE COMPUTATION
    # ==========================================================================
    if (!is.null(topo_data)) {
      for(o in offer_types) {
        neu_col <- paste0("raw_neu_", o)
        for(e in emotion_list) {
          tgt <- paste0("raw_", e, "_", o)
          if(neu_col %in% names(topo_data) & tgt %in% names(topo_data)) 
            topo_data[[paste0("conditional_diff_", e, "_vs_neu_", o)]] <- topo_data[[tgt]] - topo_data[[neu_col]]
        }
        cols <- paste0("raw_", c("neu", emotion_list), "_", o)
        valid <- cols[cols %in% names(topo_data)]
        if(length(valid)>0) topo_data[[paste0("offer_main_", o)]] <- rowMeans(topo_data[, valid], na.rm=TRUE)
      }
      
      for(e in c("neu", emotion_list)) {
        cols <- paste0("raw_", e, "_", offer_types)
        valid <- cols[cols %in% names(topo_data)]
        if(length(valid)>0) topo_data[[paste0("emotion_main_", e)]] <- rowMeans(topo_data[, valid], na.rm=TRUE)
        if(e != "neu" && paste0("emotion_main_", e) %in% names(topo_data) && "emotion_main_neu" %in% names(topo_data)) {
           topo_data[[paste0("emotion_diff_main_", e, "_vs_neu")]] <- topo_data[[paste0("emotion_main_", e)]] - topo_data[["emotion_main_neu"]]
        }
      }
      
      if("offer_main_unfair" %in% names(topo_data) && "offer_main_fair" %in% names(topo_data)) {
        topo_data[["offer_diff_main_unfair_vs_fair"]] <- topo_data[["offer_main_unfair"]] - topo_data[["offer_main_fair"]]
      }

      for(e in c("neu", emotion_list)) {
        unfair_col <- paste0("raw_", e, "_unfair")
        fair_col   <- paste0("raw_", e, "_fair")
        if(unfair_col %in% names(topo_data) && fair_col %in% names(topo_data)) {
          topo_data[[paste0("offer_diff_conditional_", e, "_unfair_vs_fair")]] <- topo_data[[unfair_col]] - topo_data[[fair_col]]
        }
      }
    }

    # ==========================================================================
    # 3.3 POOLED DYNAMIC SCALING & DIRECTORY PROVISIONING
    # ==========================================================================
    subfolder <- ifelse(method == "Regression", "Regression_Results", "Standard_Baseline")
    out_base <- file.path(current_session, subfolder, paste0("topoplots_R_", comp_name))
    
    dir_map_static <- c("raw", "diff", "emotion_main", "emotion_diff", "offer_main", "offer_diff", "offer_diff_conditional")
    walk(file.path(out_base, dir_map_static), dir_create)
    
    if (method == "Standard" && exists("raw_df")) {
      dir_map_tc <- c("raw_offer", "raw_emotion", "raw_cond", "diff_offer", "diff_emotion", "diff_cond")
      walk(file.path(out_base, "time_course_grids", dir_map_tc), dir_create)
    }
    
    topo_long <- topo_data %>% rename(electrode = channel)
    
    raw_cols  <- grep("^raw_", names(topo_long), value = TRUE)
    main_cols <- grep("_main_", names(topo_long), value = TRUE)
    
    emo_main_diff_cols   <- grep("emotion_diff_main_", names(topo_long), value = TRUE)
    offer_main_diff_cols <- grep("offer_diff_main_", names(topo_long), value = TRUE)
    cond_emo_diff_cols   <- grep("conditional_diff_", names(topo_long), value = TRUE)
    cond_offer_diff_cols <- grep("offer_diff_conditional_", names(topo_long), value = TRUE)

    raw_vals  <- if(length(raw_cols) > 0) unlist(topo_long[, raw_cols]) else 0
    main_vals <- if(length(main_cols) > 0) unlist(topo_long[, main_cols]) else 0
    
    emo_main_diff_vals   <- if(length(emo_main_diff_cols) > 0) unlist(topo_long[, emo_main_diff_cols]) else 0
    offer_main_diff_vals <- if(length(offer_main_diff_cols) > 0) unlist(topo_long[, offer_main_diff_cols]) else 0
    cond_emo_diff_vals   <- if(length(cond_emo_diff_cols) > 0) unlist(topo_long[, cond_emo_diff_cols]) else 0
    cond_offer_diff_vals <- if(length(cond_offer_diff_cols) > 0) unlist(topo_long[, cond_offer_diff_cols]) else 0
    
    if (method == "Standard" && exists("raw_df")) {
        valid_chans_tc <- intersect(names(raw_df), chanlocs$electrode)
        df_tc_scan <- raw_df %>%
          mutate(time_ms = round(time * 1000)) %>%
          filter(time_ms >= spec$win_ms[1] & time_ms <= spec$win_ms[2]) %>%
          pivot_longer(all_of(valid_chans_tc), names_to = "channel", values_to = "uV") %>%
          group_by(time, channel, emotion, offer_type) %>%
          summarise(uV = mean(uV, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
          
        raw_vals <- c(raw_vals, df_tc_scan$uV)
    }

    lims_raw  <- compute_limits(raw_vals)
    lims_main <- compute_limits(main_vals)
    
    lims_diff_emo_main   <- compute_limits(emo_main_diff_vals)
    lims_diff_offer_main <- compute_limits(offer_main_diff_vals)
    lims_diff_cond_emo   <- compute_limits(cond_emo_diff_vals)
    lims_diff_cond_offer <- compute_limits(cond_offer_diff_vals)
    
    cat(sprintf("       -> Raw bounds: [%.2f, %.2f] µV\n", lims_raw[1], lims_raw[2]))
    cat(sprintf("       -> Diff bounds (Emo Main): [%.2f, %.2f] µV\n", lims_diff_emo_main[1], lims_diff_emo_main[2]))
    cat(sprintf("       -> Diff bounds (Offer Main): [%.2f, %.2f] µV\n", lims_diff_offer_main[1], lims_diff_offer_main[2]))

    global_caption <- paste0(caption_method, "\nTime Window: ", time_win_str)

    # ==========================================================================
    # 3.4 STATIC TOPOGRAPHIC RENDERINGS
    # ==========================================================================
    # 3.4.1 Raw Topographies
    for (ofr in offer_types) {
      for (emo in c("neu", emotion_list)) {
        col <- paste0("raw_", emo, "_", ofr)
        if (col %in% names(topo_long)) {
          plot_topo_unified(
            dat_long = select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = all_of(col)), chan_locs = chanlocs, roi = spec$roi,
            main_title = paste(comp_name, title_prefix), 
            sub_title = paste("Offer:", str_to_title(ofr), "| Emotion:", emotion_labels[emo]),
            caption_text = global_caption,
            filename = file.path(out_base, "raw", paste0(comp_name, "_", ofr, "_", emo, ".png")), 
            limits = lims_raw, show_contour = TRUE
          )
        }
      }
    }
    
    # 3.4.2 Conditional Differences (Emotion - Neutral within Offer)
    for (ofr in offer_types) {
      for (emo in emotion_list) {
        col <- paste0("conditional_diff_", emo, "_vs_neu_", ofr)
        if (col %in% names(topo_long)) {
          plot_topo_unified(
            dat_long = select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = all_of(col)), chan_locs = chanlocs, roi = spec$roi,
            main_title = paste(comp_name, title_prefix, "- Contrast"), 
            sub_title = paste("Offer:", str_to_title(ofr), "| Diff:", emotion_labels[emo], "minus Neutral"),
            caption_text = global_caption,
            filename = file.path(out_base, "diff", paste0(comp_name, "_diff_", ofr, "_", emo, "_vs_neu.png")),
            limits = lims_diff_cond_emo, show_contour = FALSE 
          )
        }
      }
    }
    
    # 3.4.3 Offer Main Effect Topographies 
    for (ofr in offer_types) {
      col <- paste0("offer_main_", ofr)
      if (col %in% names(topo_long)) {
         plot_topo_unified(
          dat_long = select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = all_of(col)), chan_locs = chanlocs, roi = spec$roi,
          main_title = paste(comp_name, title_prefix, "- Main Effect"), 
          sub_title = paste("Offer Context:", str_to_title(ofr)),
          caption_text = global_caption,
          filename = file.path(out_base, "offer_main", paste0(comp_name, "_main_offer_", ofr, ".png")), 
          limits = lims_main, show_contour = TRUE 
        )
      }
    }

    # 3.4.4 Offer Main Difference (Unfair - Fair)
    if ("offer_diff_main_unfair_vs_fair" %in% names(topo_long)) {
       plot_topo_unified(
          dat_long = select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = offer_diff_main_unfair_vs_fair), chan_locs = chanlocs, roi = spec$roi,
          main_title = paste(comp_name, title_prefix, "- Main Effect"), 
          sub_title = "Unfair minus Fair Offers", 
          caption_text = global_caption,
          filename = file.path(out_base, "offer_diff", paste0(comp_name, "_diff_unfair_vs_fair.png")),
          limits = lims_diff_offer_main, show_contour = FALSE 
       )
    }

    # 3.4.5 Emotion Main Effects
    for (e in c("neu", emotion_list)) {
      col <- paste0("emotion_main_", e)
      if (col %in% names(topo_long)) {
         plot_topo_unified(
          dat_long = select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = all_of(col)), chan_locs = chanlocs, roi = spec$roi,
          main_title = paste(comp_name, title_prefix, "- Main Effect"), 
          sub_title = paste("Emotion Context:", emotion_labels[e]),
          caption_text = global_caption,
          filename = file.path(out_base, "emotion_main", paste0(comp_name, "_main_emotion_", e, ".png")), 
          limits = lims_main, show_contour = TRUE 
        )
      }
    }

    # 3.4.6 Emotion Main Differences (Emotion - Neutral)
    for (e in emotion_list) {
      col <- paste0("emotion_diff_main_", e, "_vs_neu")
      if (col %in% names(topo_long)) {
         plot_topo_unified(
          dat_long = select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = all_of(col)), chan_locs = chanlocs, roi = spec$roi,
          main_title = paste(comp_name, title_prefix, "- Contrast"), 
          sub_title = paste("Main Effect:", emotion_labels[e], "minus Neutral"), 
          caption_text = global_caption,
          filename = file.path(out_base, "emotion_diff", paste0(comp_name, "_main_diff_", e, "_vs_neu.png")),
          limits = lims_diff_emo_main, show_contour = FALSE 
        )
      }
    }
    
    # 3.4.7 Offer Conditional Differences (Unfair - Fair within Emotion)
    for (e in c("neu", emotion_list)) {
      col <- paste0("offer_diff_conditional_", e, "_unfair_vs_fair")
      if (col %in% names(topo_long)) {
         plot_topo_unified(
          dat_long = select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = all_of(col)), chan_locs = chanlocs, roi = spec$roi,
          main_title = paste(comp_name, title_prefix, "- Contrast"), 
          sub_title = paste("Unfair minus Fair | Context:", emotion_labels[e]), 
          caption_text = global_caption,
          filename = file.path(out_base, "offer_diff_conditional", paste0(comp_name, "_diff_unfair_vs_fair_in_", e, ".png")),
          limits = lims_diff_cond_offer, show_contour = FALSE 
        )
      }
    }

    # ==========================================================================
    # 3.5 SPATIOTEMPORAL MATRIX GENERATION (TIME COURSE GRIDS)
    # ==========================================================================
    if (method == "Standard" && exists("raw_df")) {
      
      tc_out_dir <- file.path(out_base, "time_course_grids")
      t_step <- time_course_step_ms
      
      tmins <- seq(spec$win_ms[1], spec$win_ms[2] - 1, by = t_step)
      
      build_tc_row <- function(df_subset, row_label, limits, roi, palette="RdBu") {
        plots <- purrr::map(tmins, function(tmin) {
          tmax <- min(tmin + t_step, spec$win_ms[2])
          
          dat <- df_subset %>%
             mutate(time_ms = round(time * 1000)) %>%
             filter(time_ms >= tmin & time_ms < tmax) %>%
             group_by(channel) %>%
             summarise(amplitude = mean(amplitude, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
             filter(!is.na(amplitude)) %>%
             rename(electrode = channel)

          if (nrow(dat) == 0) {
             return(ggplot() + theme_void() + 
                    ggtitle(paste0(tmin, "-", tmax, " ms")) +
                    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", margin = margin(b=10))))
          }

          # Using native highlights (eegUtils inherent mechanism) for maximum safety
          p_temp <- topoplot(dat, chan_locs = chanlocs, interp_limit = "head", 
                             contour = FALSE, limits = limits, palette = palette,
                             highlights = roi) 
          
          p_temp + 
            ggtitle(paste0(tmin, "-", tmax, " ms")) +
            theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", margin = margin(b=10)), 
                  legend.position = "none",
                  plot.margin = margin(15, 10, 15, 10)) 
        })
        
        label_gg <- cowplot::ggdraw() + 
                    cowplot::draw_label(row_label, fontface = "bold", size = 15, angle = 90)
        
        row_grid <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plots, nrow = 1)
        cowplot::plot_grid(label_gg, row_grid, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.12, length(tmins)))
      }

      save_mega_tc <- function(row_plots, main_title, limits, file_name, time_window, palette="RdBu") {
        dummy_df <- data.frame(electrode = chanlocs$electrode[1:2], amplitude = limits)
        bar_h <- min(length(row_plots) * 2.8, 12) 
        
        dummy_p <- topoplot(dummy_df, chan_locs = chanlocs, limits = limits, palette = palette) +
           guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title = "Amplitude\n(µV)", title.position = "top", 
                                        barheight = unit(bar_h, "cm"), barwidth = unit(0.8, "cm"))) +
           theme(legend.position = "right", 
                 legend.title = element_text(size=14, face="bold", margin=margin(b=15)),
                 legend.text = element_text(size=12),
                 legend.margin = margin(0, 20, 0, 20)) 
        shared_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(dummy_p)

        mega_stack <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = row_plots, ncol = 1)
        stack_w_leg <- cowplot::plot_grid(mega_stack, shared_legend, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(length(tmins), 0.8))

        safe_main_title <- stringr::str_wrap(paste0(main_title, " | Window: ", time_window), width = 75)
        title_gg <- cowplot::ggdraw() + 
                    cowplot::draw_label(safe_main_title, fontface = "bold", size = 20, lineheight = 1.2) +
                    theme(plot.margin = margin(25, 10, 15, 10))
                    
        final_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(title_gg, stack_w_leg, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.6, length(row_plots) * 2.8))

        dynamic_width <- max(12, 2.0 + (length(tmins) * 2.8) + 2.5)
        dynamic_height <- 2.0 + (length(row_plots) * 2.8)

        ggsave(file.path(tc_out_dir, file_name), final_plot, 
               width = dynamic_width, height = dynamic_height, dpi = 300, bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE)
      }

      valid_chans_tc <- intersect(names(raw_df), chanlocs$electrode)
      df_tc_base <- raw_df %>%
        pivot_longer(all_of(valid_chans_tc), names_to = "channel", values_to = "uV") %>%
        group_by(time, channel, emotion, offer_type) %>%
        summarise(uV = mean(uV, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")

      row_plots <- list()
      for (ofr in offer_types) {
        df_slice <- df_tc_base %>% filter(offer_type == ofr) %>%
                    group_by(time, channel) %>% summarise(amplitude = mean(uV, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
        row_plots[[length(row_plots)+1]] <- build_tc_row(df_slice, paste("Offer:", str_to_title(ofr)), lims_raw, spec$roi)
      }
      save_mega_tc(row_plots, paste(comp_name, "Evolution: Main Effects of Offer"), 
                   lims_raw, file.path("raw_offer", paste0(comp_name, "_TC_Raw_Offer.png")), time_win_str)

      row_plots <- list()
      for (emo in c("neu", emotion_list)) {
        df_slice <- df_tc_base %>% filter(emotion == emo) %>%
                    group_by(time, channel) %>% summarise(amplitude = mean(uV, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
        row_plots[[length(row_plots)+1]] <- build_tc_row(df_slice, paste("Emotion:", emotion_labels[emo]), lims_raw, spec$roi)
      }
      save_mega_tc(row_plots, paste(comp_name, "Evolution: Main Effects of Emotion"), 
                   lims_raw, file.path("raw_emotion", paste0(comp_name, "_TC_Raw_Emotion.png")), time_win_str)

      row_plots <- list()
      for (emo in c("neu", emotion_list)) {
        for (ofr in offer_types) {
          df_slice <- df_tc_base %>% filter(offer_type == ofr, emotion == emo) %>% rename(amplitude = uV)
          row_label <- paste0(emotion_labels[emo], "\n(", str_to_title(ofr), ")")
          row_plots[[length(row_plots)+1]] <- build_tc_row(df_slice, row_label, lims_raw, spec$roi)
        }
      }
      save_mega_tc(row_plots, paste(comp_name, "Evolution: Offer Type per Emotional Context"), 
                   lims_raw, file.path("raw_cond", paste0(comp_name, "_TC_Raw_Conditional.png")), time_win_str)

      row_plots <- list()
      df_slice <- df_tc_base %>%
        group_by(time, channel, offer_type) %>%
        summarise(uV = mean(uV, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = offer_type, values_from = uV) %>%
        mutate(amplitude = unfair - fair)
      row_plots[[length(row_plots)+1]] <- build_tc_row(df_slice, "Unfair - Fair\n(Aggregated)", lims_diff_offer_main, spec$roi)
      save_mega_tc(row_plots, paste(comp_name, "Spatiotemporal Contrast: Unfair minus Fair"), 
                   lims_diff_offer_main, file.path("diff_offer", paste0(comp_name, "_TC_Diff_Offer_Main.png")), time_win_str)

      row_plots <- list()
      for (emo in emotion_list) {
        df_slice <- df_tc_base %>%
          filter(emotion %in% c(emo, "neu")) %>%
          group_by(time, channel, emotion) %>%
          summarise(uV = mean(uV, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
          pivot_wider(names_from = emotion, values_from = uV) %>%
          mutate(amplitude = !!sym(emo) - neu)
        row_plots[[length(row_plots)+1]] <- build_tc_row(df_slice, paste0(emotion_labels[emo], "\n- Neutral"), lims_diff_emo_main, spec$roi)
      }
      save_mega_tc(row_plots, paste(comp_name, "Spatiotemporal Contrast: Emotion minus Neutral"), 
                   lims_diff_emo_main, file.path("diff_emotion", paste0(comp_name, "_TC_Diff_Emotion_Main.png")), time_win_str)

      row_plots <- list()
      for (emo in c("neu", emotion_list)) {
        df_slice <- df_tc_base %>%
          filter(emotion == emo) %>%
          group_by(time, channel, offer_type) %>%
          summarise(uV = mean(uV, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
          pivot_wider(names_from = offer_type, values_from = uV) %>%
          mutate(amplitude = unfair - fair)
        row_plots[[length(row_plots)+1]] <- build_tc_row(df_slice, paste0("Unfair - Fair\n(", emotion_labels[emo], ")"), lims_diff_cond_offer, spec$roi)
      }
      save_mega_tc(row_plots, paste(comp_name, "Spatiotemporal Contrast: Conditional Interactions"), 
                   lims_diff_cond_offer, file.path("diff_cond", paste0(comp_name, "_TC_Diff_Conditional.png")), time_win_str)
    }
    
    cat(sprintf("    Exportation complete. Assets localized at: %s\n", out_base))
  }
  
  graphics.off()
  closeAllConnections()
  gc(verbose = FALSE)
}
```
